_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Merchant cash advances & predatory lenders
categories.description: Daily debits, factor rates, loan stacking, confessions of judgment, loan sharks.
keywords: merchant cash advance|\bmca\b|daily (payments|debits)|factor rate|stacking|predatory|confession of judgment|loan shark

categories.name: Defaults, NPA & recovery pressure
categories.description: Accounts turning NPA, SARFAESI, recovery action, restructuring and settlements.

categories.name: Collateral & personal guarantee demands
categories.description: Lenders demanding property, FDs or personal guarantees even for small loans.

categories.name: Rejected or can't qualify
categories.description: Turned down over business vintage, turnover, credit history or sector.
keywords: reject|denied|declined|not eligible|eligib|qualify|vintage|turnover (criteria|requirement)|minimum (turnover|revenue)|time in business|years in business

categories.name: Paperwork, GST/ITR & financials demands
categories.description: Endless documents: GST returns, ITRs, bank statements, audited financials, CMA data.
keywords: documents?|paperwork|\bitr\b|gst (returns?|filing|data)|bank statements?|balance sheet|audited|udyam|project report|cma data|financial statements

categories.name: Slow sanction & disbursal
categories.description: Weeks or months from application to money in the account.

categories.name: Working capital, OD & CC limits
categories.description: Too-small, cut or hard-to-renew overdraft, cash-credit and credit lines.
keywords: working capital|\bod\b|overdraft|cash credit|\bcc (limit|account)\b|line of credit|credit line|limit (reduced|cut|enhancement|renewal|increase)|drawing power

categories.name: Delayed customer payments & receivables
categories.description: Large buyers paying late, long payment terms starving cash flow.
keywords: delayed payments?|late payments?|payment terms|receivables|invoices? (unpaid|overdue|not paid)|45 days|samadhaan|debtors|net ?(30|60|90)|cash ?flow

categories.name: Invoice discounting, factoring & TReDS
categories.description: Getting invoices financed: discounting, factoring, TReDS and supply-chain finance.
keywords: invoice (discount|financ|factor)|factoring|\btreds\b|supply chain financ|reverse factoring|bill discounting|receivables financ

categories.name: Government schemes (Mudra, CGTMSE, SBA...)
categories.description: Hard to access or slow government-backed schemes and guarantees.
keywords: mudra|cgtmse|pmegp|stand ?up india|\bsba\b|7\(a\)|\b504\b|start ?up loan|british business bank|bounce ?back|eclgs|recovery loan scheme|subsid|scheme

categories.name: High rates, processing & hidden fees
categories.description: High interest or factor rates, processing, prepayment and penal charges.

categories.name: Business credit score & bureau issues
categories.description: Low or wrong commercial scores (CMR, Paydex), personal score dragging the business.

categories.name: Fintech & digital lending experience
categories.description: Online lenders and apps: instant-loan promises, app issues, opaque decisions.

categories.name: Bank & NBFC relationship and support
categories.description: Unresponsive relationship managers, branches, complaints and ombudsman.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.

personas.name: Manufacturer
personas.description: Runs a factory or production unit.

personas.name: Exporter / importer
personas.description: Trades across borders; needs trade finance.

personas.name: Supplier / contractor to large buyers
personas.description: Sells to corporates or government and waits to be paid.

personas.name: Sole proprietor / self-employed
personas.description: Very small business run by one person.
